faults.rationale: Identity check replaces truthiness: an empty scope mapping {} is now returned as-is instead of the default synthetic_fixture scope.
Reuses the caller's mapping instead of copying it, so the verdict scope aliases the caller's object and later caller mutation changes the verdict.

Truthiness instead of `is True`: protected_effect_observed values like 1 or "false" now produce VIOLATED instead of NOT_ESTABLISHED.
